methodology: Real offline release HTML, real session and localStorage. Test-only hooks seed facilities and inject quota; no prototype renderer or image acceptance.

steps.name: normal offline entry has no test globals; default old shortcut shares upgraded v2
facade buy and old tab use the same profile; cart itself is disposable
quota injection rolls back facility, cash and success events; retry is single
real five-second practice checkpoint failure retains export and blocks shortcut writes
prepared departure survives reload during animation without duplicate run count
real city settlement disposes host; return marker is nonpersistent and single-use
animation-complete bridge starts the existing city host exactly once
real storage peer conflict is read-only and keeps the latest bytes
